louisella.notes: Whole-organism goal. Four trunk zones, paired papilla rows, spine-bearing proboscis and unspined rear distinguish from Ottoia. Complete specimen USNM57616. Miskoia is synonym, not new count. Reconstruction illustration and original specimen photographs on page; historic retouched drawings should not displace actual fossil photos.

hoodoo.notes: Generic thin irregular pillar and smaller resistant cap, distinct from much wider balanced boulder. Source shows sedimentary hardness contrast and erosion. No Bryce dimensions/stratigraphic age claimed.

graben-basin.figure: USGS Bulletin1327 Fig55 simple graben, printedp80, verify actual PDF page and image
graben-basin.notes: Depressed middle block, opposing normal faults, relative displacement not merely erosion valley. Generic demonstration; no named rift geometry.

meandering-river-reach.notes: Original inventory source, maker still needs actual subject photo/diagram and source text. Inside deposition versus outside erosion must be visible; full channel bend not oxbow-only asset.

marpolia.notes: Original inventory reconstruction_type specimen. Small tuft of many fine basal-branched filaments, no single trunk or ribbon leaves. M.spissa ROM57841 actual photo and USNM35403 type. Do not use M.aequalis USNM35412 stronger central branching or heavily retouched historicimage as M.spissa. Affinity treated as cyanobacterium, floating/attachment uncertainty explicit; no invented root.

balanced-rock.notes: Broad boulder with narrower attached pedestal. No floating contact or isolated sphere balancing claim. Generic form, not exact Arches replica/stratigraphy. Distinct silhouette from thin hoodoo.

u-shaped-glacial-valley.notes: Original inventory source; actual photo still to inspect. Broad trough floor and steep walls distinguish V-shaped river canyon. Generic not exact park or glacial history.

desert-pavement.notes: Original aeolian overview only names pavement; actual close-set clast photo/formation reference must be inspected. Use dense fitted coarse mantle, not random sparse stones. Keep process uncertainty: do not assert only wind deflation if unsourced.

rejected_for_this_wave.protospongia: ROM Burgess specimens are fragmentary and full shape/size unresolved there; whole-body cross-deposit reconstruction requires more work before freeze. Not produced or counted.
